items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: And we went over to the show with Miss Young -- on the show with her.

ctx.x: But you were going to say you knew why he had gone.

No, I was saying I knew why he had taken us, me and Pete. Because we were the best players, and he wanted to take us with him. We joined the show from Carbondale, Illinois, I think it was. That's where we left from. And we went over to the show with Miss Young -- on the show with her. And we stayed on that show until it closed. That show closed in Elrino, Oklahoma.
